evals.prompt: /v-audit-consolidate, where PROJECT_ROOT contains PRELAUNCH_READINESS_REPORT_a.md flagging 'Broken OG image path' at resources/js/Pages/Marketing/Pricing.tsx:296 (M-OG-001, MUST-FIX) and GAUNTLET_REPORT_b.md flagging the same file:line as 'OG image 404s' (OG-01, CRITICAL)
evals.expected_output: Both findings fingerprint to the same sha1(file:line:category_slug) and merge into ONE consolidated finding with sources listing both originals, canonical_severity P0 (worst-case of MUST-FIX/CRITICAL per severity-mapping.md), and a single fix entry in the prompt pack — not two packs fixing the same thing.

evals.prompt: /v-audit-consolidate consuming two reports where one source audit's verdict line is BLOCK_OVERRIDDEN (operator --force) and its findings include a P1
evals.expected_output: The consolidated verdict treats the overridden source as NEEDS-WORK with a flag (never re-escalates to BLOCK), the report renders the operator-override callout from consolidation-rules.md, and that source's findings land ONLY in the '## Appendix: BLOCK_OVERRIDDEN sources' section — never mixed into the main severity backlog (Gotcha 3).

evals.prompt: /v-audit-consolidate consuming a report from a new audit skill whose native severity term 'SHOWSTOPPER' has no (source_skill, native_severity) row in references/severity-mapping.md
evals.expected_output: The finding is assigned canonical_severity P2 with severity_unmapped: true, a warning is logged, the 'Severity-unmapped findings' stats row counts it, and the run does NOT crash or silently drop the finding.

evals.prompt: /v-audit-consolidate where two consolidated findings touch the SAME file (app/Http/Controllers/BillingController.php) with DIFFERENT remedies (one adds rate limiting, one refactors an N+1 query)
evals.expected_output: The two findings are NOT merged (different category_slug → different fingerprints) and are assigned to DIFFERENT waves (w1-/w2-), never the same wave — the parallel-safety invariant. Step 8's run-v-packs --dry-run self-validate confirms the wave split before handoff.

evals.prompt: /v-audit-consolidate on a project where discovery finds 0 audit reports in the window
evals.expected_output: RED fixture for the abandonment gap: the skill exits early with the 'no audit reports found' message but STILL writes a minimal CONSOLIDATED_AUDIT_REPORT_${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID}.md (heading, generated line, verdict: NOT-RUN, 'Generated by v-audit-consolidate' provenance line) so the Stop hook's report-only escape has an artifact to validate. Exiting with no artifact is a failure.

evals.prompt: /v-audit-consolidate where a duplicate cluster ties on fix-description length between a v-check finding and a v-anti-template-gauntlet finding
evals.expected_output: The tie-break resolves deterministically: v-anti-template-gauntlet (middle tier) beats v-check (lowest tier, its ONLY tier in consolidation-rules.md) as the primary finding. Two runs on the same input must pick the same primary.

evals.prompt: /v-audit-consolidate where one of three discovered reports is malformed JSON the parser subprocess cannot read
evals.expected_output: The Step 2 subprocess returns it in parse_errors; the consolidated report renders a '## Parse warnings' section naming the report and reason, the stats table counts it, and Step 10's console summary states findings from that source are NOT included. Silently consolidating only the two parseable reports with no warning is a failure.

evals.prompt: /v-audit-consolidate consuming ANALYTICS_AUDIT_x.md with `analytics_health: UNRELIABLE` (fired purely on overall_score < 4, ZERO P0 findings in the report — only P1/P2s) alongside a clean v-check report
evals.expected_output: Step 2's report_verdicts array captures source_verdict: 'UNRELIABLE' for the analytics report (this is the ONLY place a score-driven verdict with no P0 findings is captured — per-finding severities alone would never surface it). Step 6 maps it via severity-mapping.md's Verdict vocabulary mapping to canonical BLOCK and the consolidated verdict is BLOCK, even though zero consolidated findings have canonical_severity P0. A consolidated verdict of PASS or NEEDS-WORK here is the exact dead-wiring bug this eval guards against.
